title: Practical Scaling Laws: Converting Compute into Performance in a Data-Constrained World
abstract: arXiv:2605.09189v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The scaling laws guiding modern model training were calibrated for a single regime: data-rich, single-epoch pretraining. The dominant such scaling law form, Chinchilla's $L = E + A/N^\alpha + B/D^\beta$, has three structural limitations outside that regime: it diverges as unique data shrinks instead of saturating at the uninformed baseline; it cannot represent overfitting when capacity exceeds the data; and it conflates total examples seen with unique examples available. We propose a closed-form extension, $L(N, D, T) = E + (L_0 - E)\,h/(1+h)$ with $h = a/N^\alpha + b/T^\beta + c\,N^\gamma/D^\delta$, that decomposes loss into undercapacity, undertraining, and overfitting terms. It saturates between the irreducible loss $E$ and an uninformed baseline $L_0$ fixed by the loss type, and reduces to Chinchilla in the data-rich, single-epoch limit. translated_title: 实用缩放定律：在数据受限的世界中将算力转化为性能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09189v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：指导现代模型训练的缩放定律是为单一场景校准的：数据丰富、单轮次（single-epoch）预训练。占主导地位的此类缩放定律形式——Chinchilla 的 $L = E + A/N^\alpha + B/D^\beta$——在该场景之外存在三个结构性局限：当唯一数据减少时它会发散，而不是在无信息基线处饱和；当模型容量超过数据量时，它无法刻画过拟合现象；并且它将已见样本总数与可用唯一样本数混为一谈。我们提出一个闭式扩展，$L(N, D, T) = E + (L_0 - E)\,h/(1+h)$，其中 $h = a/N^\alpha + b/T^\beta + c\,N^\gamma/D^\delta$，该公式将损失分解为容量不足、训练不足和过拟合三项。它在不可约损失 $E$ 与由损失类型确定的无信息基线 $L_0$ 之间饱和，并且在数据丰富、单轮次训练的极限情况下退化为 Chinchilla 缩放定律。我们在跨越四个架构家族（MLPs、Res...）的四个多轮次实验上对其进行了验证。
tldr: 提出了一个闭式缩放定律扩展，将损失分解为容量不足、训练不足和过拟合三项，在数据受限的多轮次训练中能于无信息基线处饱和，并在数据丰富、单轮次极限下退化为 Chinchilla 缩放定律。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a closed-form extension of scaling laws that decomposes loss into undercapacity, undertraining, and overfitting terms, saturating at an uninformed baseline in data-constrained multi-epoch regimes while reducing to Chinchilla's law in the data-rich, single-epoch limit.
